patch_description: This design keeps the effective ingredients of the stronger current circuit—local feature adaptation, parity-aware regularization, full-chain connectivity, and a noncommuting output mixer—while removing its three redundant phase-entangling sandwiches. A single linear CZ backbone is augmented immediately on every edge by commuting CRZ correlations, using only two shared parameters for alternating even and odd bonds. Independent RY angles retain local expressivity, while shared pre-entanglement RZ and post-entanglement RX rotations constrain parameter growth and should reduce overfitting. The resulting block is substantially smaller than the current ansatz, targeting better parameter efficiency, lower depth and gate count, and faster convergence without sacrificing full-chain correlation coverage.
